evidence.detail: # is_timeout = sa.Column(sa.Boolean) — field is commented out, showing the feature was considered but not implemented
only REGEX_GAME_HEADER, REGEX_SWITCHEROO, REGEX_GATHERLING, REGEX_ROUND are parsed; no pattern for 'player has timed out'
current help text tells users to report manually when opponent times out — confirms the auto-detection is not implemented

triage.notes: Implementing this requires: determining the exact log message PDBot emits on timeout, adding a REGEX_TIMEOUT pattern in logsite/importing.py, setting match.is_timeout and awarding wins, and a schema migration to add the is_timeout column. The Discord message 199349148 (referenced in the issue) would provide the precise log text but is not accessible statically.
